about: The positive controls of the exploring spec: each property of ../explore.ts goes red in at least one of them. A control with a patch runs on a throwaway build of this checkout with the patch applied (expected: every property under red goes red) and on this checkout as it is (expected: nothing red). One without a patch causes its conditions itself. 'backendLog' stands for an Unhandled error in the session's backend log. prep: control-prism commands run after the model recipe, before Bombadil starts. Run them with: node scripts/control-prism.mjs explore --control all
